jobs_results.title: Sr. Software QA Engineer
jobs_results.description:
Description

Malwarebytes believes that when people and organizations are free from threats, they are free to thrive. Founded in 2008, CEO Marcin Kleczynski had one mission: to rid the world of malware. Today, Malwarebytes has grown beyond malware remediation to ensuring cyberprotection for everyone, providing device protection, privacy, and prevention solutions in the home, on-the-go, at work, or on campus. With threat hunters and innovators across the world, we want great people, like YOU, to join our team! 

Malwarebytes is looking for...

a customer-centric QA Engineer to lead its current and new quality initiatives. Quality is paramount to business success; the QA Engineer will ensure that best practices are followed across engineering that make quality as a differentiator for all our products. Not only quality issues have to be assessed and resolved as quickly as possible, at times they require highly skilled specialists who are familiar with our services and software... architecture alike and bring the learnings from customers into how we test. QA Engineer will ensure they will collaborate rest of the engineering team and maximize everyone’s potential to help us ship on time, with quality.

 

What You'll Do
• Design, plan, execute, monitor, and improve testing processes for Windows products
• Work independently and influence teams
• Oversee/ensure the quality of test plans, test cases, test matrix, and bug reporting
• Provide extensive experience in a range of security technologies from endpoint to cloud
• Experience debugging memory corruptions, process contentions, and system performance
• Windows Kernel development, security-oriented development, reversing or malware analysis
• Hands-on experience and in-depth understanding of Windows OS design & internals, and with debugging of Windows applications and familiarity with related standard debugging and profiling tools
• Have a deep technology understanding with hands-on experience in performance test methodologies
• Mastery of automation and automated testing; work with Automation Engineers and Software Developers to establish and maintain a roadmap to develop and integrate further automation, performance, and security testing
• Research and recommend new tools, techniques, and testing methodologies as needed to improve productivity and quality of work
• Provide regular updates with respect to progress on tasks and projects. Perform root cause analysis of complex issues
• Provide end-user support as needed to resolve production or customer issues

 

Skills You’ll Need To Have
• A bachelor’s degree in computer science or engineering
• Coding skills that can fix minor issues without developer involvement
• 8+ years of work experience in a similar field or equivalent
• Empathy and Soft Skills Master: You are able to keep customers happy and stress levels down during difficult situations. You have a passion for engineering customer satisfaction
• Quick Learner: You demonstrate an aptitude and appetite for learning new technologies and applying this to solve customer issues
• Team Player: You are not alone. Your team members and you form a tribe together

Benefits And Perks
• An opportunity to do something great for yourself and the world
• A great work environment that supports growth, development, and most importantly having fun!
• Employee Referral Bonus Program
• Wellness programs

jobs_results.description:
Descripción

Hola ¿Eres apasionado/a por la calidad en los productos digitales y te encanta liderar equipos? Entonces esta oferta es para ti En SG Tech estamos en búsqueda de un/a QA Lead con al menos 3 años de experiência para unirse a nuestro increíble equipo.
• *Acerca de SG Tech**:
Somos una empresa en constante crecimiento, dedicada a la innovación y desarrollo de productos digitales. En este momento, estamos construyendo la línea del QA y buscamos a un/a líder que sea capaz de construir la estrategia a seguir, liderar un equipo de QA y responsabilizarse por la calidad de nuestros productos.
• *Funciones principales**:
Como QA Lead en SG Tech, tus responsabilidades principales serán:

- Construir y liderar el equipo de QA
- Definir la estrategia de QA a seguir
- Planificar, coordinar y dirigir las actividades de pruebas
- Identificar y proponer herramientas de automatización
- Colaborar estrechamente con otros departamentos para garantizar la calidad en todos los procesos
• *¿Qué... ofrecemos?**:

- Ambiente de trabajo dinámico y creativo
- Modelo híbrido en Leganés (Madrid)
- Horario flexible de 9:00 a 18:00
- Oportunidades de desarrollo profesional y crecimiento dentro de la empresa
- Viajar puntualmente
- Acceso a retribución flexible.
• *Requisitos**:

- Titulación técnica superior de informática (Universitaria)
- Experiência mínima de 3 años en puestos similares
- Conocimiento de metodologías ágiles, especialmente Scrum
- Experiência en automatización de software
- Nível de inglés C1
- Disponibilidad para viajar puntualmente

Únete a nuestra familia y juntos construyamos productos digitales increíbles

3 years

jobs_results.title: Senior Software Quality Assurance Engineer (Remote, Spain based...
jobs_results.description:
One of the companies we work with is looking for a Senior Software Quality Assurance Engineer to join the team.

Remote candidates must be living (or willing to live) in: Spain.

Job description

As a QA Engineer, you will work together with our development team, product managers, and designers. We pride ourselves on working in an evolving and agile environment, with day-to-day interaction with every member of the team. No bureaucracy or hierarchy. We rather give you space to build, to collaborate and to create value and direct impact to our users. We love to find team members that challenge and question the features they are working on.

Our tech stack is second to none, so be ready to shoot to the moon and beyond. Our Frontend is built with ReactJS. It keeps us moving fast and scale up, but with strong resiliency. We use Figma to build our proprietary Design System and UI Kit. Our Backend runs on Node JS and our platform on Google GCP, using Firebase as our center of command.

What... will you do?
• Work with an experienced development team and product managers to ideate, brainstorm and build impressive financial features. Code hard, think hard.
• Test all new features and enhancements to ensure responsiveness and efficiency. This includes mastering troubleshooting, debugging and upgrades.
• Work with product managers to identify automated tests as part of implementing new functionalities.
• Design and implement automated tests, conduct automated and manual test runs, debug and define corrective actions as part of the development process and before production releases.
• Help build continuous integration together with the development team.
• Work in a comfortable and rewarding environment, making sure that this company's culture and mission is safeguarded and spread.
• Be ready to develop skills and learn from other areas they might have expertise on.

What are we looking for?
• 3-5 years of experience as a QA/SW engineer. You are comfortable with the overall JavaScript framework. You have previous knowledge of software QA methodologies and testing tools/frameworks (e.g. Jest, Selenium, Pytest, Karate, Cucumber). Background studies related to Computer Science of software development are important.
• You like taking responsibility, ownership and creating impact. We need builders and problem solvers who feel proud and liable for our success. Advocate a quality culture across the whole this company's organization.
• You are comfortable with testing environments and make sure every detail is brushed before going to production. You are passionate about high quality.
• You are highly organized and can adjust priorities, having great attention to detail. You understanding the difference between perfect and a good-enough result
• Team player: “We” is always before “I”. We need versatility, humility, and team members that enjoy working and learning from each other.
• You are ambitious: curious to learn about new tools and getting to the bottom of each problem
• Languages: Working proficiency in English & fluent in Spanish
• Location: preferably in Madrid or elsewhere in Spain. If you don't live in Madrid, we will need you to come once a month for team meetings, team building... of course, we will cover the expenses.

Additionally, any of the below would definitely be great:
• Familiarity with the rest of our technological stack (React, NodeJS, Python, GCP, Gitlab CI/CD).
• Experience with CI/CD processes and DevOps practices.
• Knowledge of tracking test coverage tools and quality monitoring.
• Previous experience in the financial industry or fintechs.
• International experience and additional languages are key to embracing our inclusive culture.
• We love people that are opinionated and are not afraid of disagreeing.
• Collaboration in open-source projects

What comes with working at this company?

We offer a platform that allows you to reach your professional and personal goals. We pride ourselves on working in an evolving and agile environment, with day-to-day interaction with every member of the team. No bureaucracy or hierarchy. We rather give you space to lead, build, collaborate and create value to our users.

Additionally, being in this company also comes with the following benefits:
• A competitive salary according to the project and responsibility
• Hybrid working setup & flexible schedule
• Latest technology of your choice to do your impactful work with
• Access to private health insurance with Sanitas
• Access to salary on demand, restaurante card, transport card, and kindergarden checks through Payflow
• Career progression - we are a small team with great ambitions.
• An opportunity to work hand in hand with our founders who built their careers in Investment Banking at J.P. Morgan for more than a decade.
• Twice-yearly performance reviews
• 360º development - through internal and external talks, sponsored conferences and many more to come
• Fruit and coffee at the office!
• Team Buildings plans

Hiring Process

The process consists of 3 phases:
• 1st interview/call with Head of People
• 2nd technical interview with a couple of people from the team
• 3rd and last with the CTO

Joppy is a tech recruitment platform built for developers by developers.

✅ No CV required. Just say what you know and what you want.

✅ Anonymous profile by default.

✅ You choose who can talk to you. Companies can't write to you until you accept their offer.

✅ Only relevant offers matching your preferences. No more Javascript offers for Java developers.

✅ Get a reward if you get hired.

Keep an eye on tech job opportunities anonymously and match the job that makes you happy

• An opportunity to work hand in hand with our founders who built their careers in Investment Banking at J.P. Morgan for more than a decade.
• Twice-yearly performance reviews
• 360º development - through internal and external talks, sponsored conferences and many more to come
• Fruit and coffee at the office!
• Team Buildings plans

Hiring Process

The process consists of 3 phases:
• 1st interview/call with Head of People
• 2nd technical interview with a couple of people from the team
• 3rd and last with the CTO

Joppy is a tech recruitment platform built for developers by developers.

✅ No CV required. Just say what you know and what you want.

✅ Anonymous profile by default.

✅ You choose who can talk to you. Companies can't write to you until you accept their offer.

✅ Only relevant offers matching your preferences. No more Javascript offers for Java developers.

✅ Get a reward if you get hired.

Keep an eye on tech job opportunities anonymously and match the job that makes you happy
